hooks.name: Page budget guard
hooks.description: When the planner, escalation, runtime, pager codes or the prep-time learner change, restate Revenant's paging rules and ask for a unit test before continuing.

action.prompt: You just edited the paging engine. Before continuing, confirm: (1) no page fires at an event's start unless the action is to start (focus block or video call); (2) the beeping pages per local day never exceed settings.dailyBudget, and anything cut lands in that day's digest; (3) the engine stays pure, with no Date.now(), randomness, storage or network; (4) ACK still cancels every later repeat of that page; (5) src/engine/learn.ts only returns suggestions and never changes a commitment, and applying one never adds a page. Add or update a unit test under tests/unit for any rule you changed, then run `npm test`.
